officialSource.basis: rendered from the official file this pack installed, re-hashed from the same bytes the renderer was handed

notice.basis: read from the official source's own glyphs, decoded through each font's ToUnicode map

disposition.ownershipDetermination: Participant-filled packet form: overlay bindings permitted for participant/deterministic facts only.

withdrawnFixture.why: These fixtures were written before this remediation and were never regenerated: 48 live AcroForm fields survived on both, they were serialized with object streams so the active-content scan could not see into them, and no provenance record named either one. They presented as finalized participant artifacts and were not.
withdrawnFixture.notReplaced: This family package is a duplicate. vermont/200-00130-form-en covers the same document, pinned to the same source sha256 ff914f49c2a78a8b96d48f1242b70ab12ff7cb25beeeb8b850505357fdf982ed with the same role and library folder, and it is the one the implementation index carries. This package is not in that index at all.
withdrawnFixture.whatThisIsNotSaying: Nothing here decides whether the duplicate package should exist. It says only that its fixtures described a run that no longer describes anything, and that leaving them in place left two files claiming to be filed participant documents when they were unflattened blanks.

disposition.anIntentionallyAbsentArtifactIsNotAVisua: this family's terminal state requires that no participant PDF exist; the evidence records the official source in full and the absence, and manufactures nothing to compare it against
